$comment: Named brand palettes for a NEW Mini App (an existing project keeps its own colours: references/mini-apps/design-system.md section 9.4). Values are Apple's iOS and iPadOS system colours as published in the Human Interface Guidelines colour table (default light, default dark, increased-contrast light, increased-contrast dark), read on 2026-11-24 from the page's swatch data; the page's change log dates the values to 2025-06-09, and red, orange, green, blue and gray match the iOS 27 Figma kit read earlier. A palette colours ONE brand moment per screen; surfaces, text, buttons and links stay the user's Telegram theme. No source kit ships gradients: the only gradient a palette makes is the tonal brand-to-page fade of .tma-hero.

by_product.$comment: [Heuristic] a starting point, not a rule: pick one, say why in one line, and avoid the colour the product's status colours already use (red, green).
